answer: Optical token attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to unique physical microstructures. Verifiers on an elevated knoll probe each agent's cultured pearl resonator with a coherent optical signal, measuring the scattered speckle pattern. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of deploying distinct physical biomineral tags per identity. However, ambient dust or micro-abrasions degrade surface reflectance, causing false rejections of honest agents.
